meta.title: 3otla — Public holidays in Morocco
meta.description: Every public holiday in Morocco, national and religious, with its status (fixed, estimated, confirmed) and official source. Calendar, countdown and a free API.
meta.yearDescription: {year} calendar of public holidays in Morocco: national and religious holidays, estimated and confirmed dates, with official sources.
meta.holidayDescription: {name} {year} in Morocco: {date}. Status: {status}. Official source and countdown.

home.intro: Morocco’s public holidays, each date with its status and official source.

status.fixedHelp: Same date every year, set by official texts.
status.estimatedHelp: Estimated with the Umm al-Qura calendar. In Morocco the date depends on moon sighting and can be one day later.
status.confirmedHelp: Date officially announced by the Ministry of Habous and Islamic Affairs.

holiday.estimateNote: Estimated date: it will be confirmed after the official moon-sighting announcement.

calendar.title: {year} calendar
calendar.count: {count, plural, one {# public holiday} other {# public holidays}}

subscribe.title: Add to your calendar
subscribe.hint: Estimated dates update automatically once confirmed.

sources.title: Sources and method
sources.intro: Every date on 3otla shows its status and links to an official source. We never use aggregators or news sites as sources.
sources.nationalBody: National holidays follow the official list published on Morocco’s national portal (maroc.ma) and the corresponding decrees.
sources.religiousBody: Religious holiday dates are first estimated with the Umm al-Qura calendar. Morocco sets these dates by local moon sighting, so the actual date can be one day later. Once the Ministry of Habous announces the date, it becomes “confirmed” with a link to the announcement.
sources.correctionsBody: The data is public and versioned on GitHub. Every correction must cite an official source.
sources.licenseBody: Data under CC BY 4.0, code under MIT.

footer.tagline: Morocco’s public holidays, with their sources.

school.title: School holidays {schoolYear}
school.metaDescription: Official {schoolYear} school holiday calendar in Morocco, from the Ministry of National Education decision, with the official source and a countdown.
school.intro: Morocco’s official school holidays, from the decision published by the Ministry of National Education.
school.notHolidays: School breaks are not public holidays: they don’t change working days. Public holidays come on top of them.
school.over: All breaks of this school year are over.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.metaDescription: Report a mistake or send an official announcement (Eid, school calendar). Every contribution is reviewed before it is published.
contribute.intro: Spotted a wrong date, or an official announcement just came out? Send it here. Every contribution is reviewed by a maintainer before it is published.
contribute.step1: You send the form with a link to an official source.
contribute.step2: Your contribution waits, privately, for an admin’s review.
contribute.step3: If accepted, an announced date shows up on the site and in the API right away. If rejected, nothing changes.

confirmation.title: Religious holiday announcement
confirmation.desc: The Ministry of Habous announced the date of Eid, Mawlid or the Islamic New Year.

correction.title: Fix a mistake
correction.desc: A date, name or source is wrong on the site or in the API.

school-calendar.title: New school calendar
school-calendar.desc: The Ministry of National Education published the calendar for a new school year.

fields.announcedAt: Date and time of the announcement (Morocco time)
fields.subject: What is wrong?
fields.subjectHint: For example “Eid al-Adha 2027” or the page address.
fields.detailsHint: Explain the mistake and what the official source says.
fields.sourceHint: maroc.ma, a .gov.ma site (habous.gov.ma, men.gov.ma) or MAP. Aggregators and news sites are not accepted.

contribute.publicNotice: An admin reviews every contribution before anything changes on the site. Don’t include personal information.

errors.url: Enter a full address starting with https://
errors.source: Source not accepted: use maroc.ma, a .gov.ma site or MAP.
errors.implausible: This date is more than 2 days from the estimate. Please check the announcement.
errors.rateLimited: Too many submissions. Try again in a few minutes.

success.title: Thank you, it’s sent!
success.body: Your contribution is waiting for an admin’s review.

disabled.title: Sending is unavailable
disabled.body: Contributions can’t be received right now. Please try again later.

admin.title: Contributions
admin.signInBody: Only approved GitHub accounts can review contributions.
admin.appliesLive: Accepting applies this date live on the site and in the API.
admin.recordOnly: Accepting records the decision. The data itself has to be updated by hand.

errors.forbidden: This account is not allowed to review contributions.
errors.not_configured: Admin sign-in is not configured on this server.
errors.store: Contribution storage (Upstash Redis) is not configured.
errors.already_confirmed: This holiday is already confirmed. Revert the other confirmation first.
errors.not_accepted: Only accepted contributions can be reverted.
